errors.text_span: 刻度范围从0到180,000，以20,000为间隔
errors.evidence: The left y-axis, representing daily new patient numbers, has a scale from 0 to 1,800,000 with intervals of 200,000, not 0 to 180,000 with intervals of 20,000.
The right y-axis label is "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Number of daily news media reports) and does not specify the unit "篇" (articles).

errors.text_span: 其数值在2022年7月1日约为90,000人
errors.evidence: The value of the bar on July 1, 2022, is approximately 950,000, not 90,000. The reported value is off by a factor of more than 10.

errors.text_span: 随后在7月15日达到峰值约160,000人
errors.evidence: The peak value of the bars around July 15 is approximately 1,600,000, not 160,000. The reported value is off by a factor of 10.
The value of the bar on August 26 is approximately 800,000, not 80,000. The reported value is off by a factor of 10.

errors.text_span: 随后在7月15日达到峰值约5,000篇
errors.evidence: The peak value of the line chart around mid-July is visibly above the 5,000 mark, reaching approximately 5,500.

errors.text_span: 旨在呈现突发公共卫生事件期间公众关注与疫情发展之间的动态关系
errors.evidence: This part of the description interprets the purpose of the chart, which is not explicitly stated in the chart's title or labels. The title is purely descriptive: "Trend of daily new patient numbers and news media report numbers".
